answer: An aspiring-page record carries four attributes: `name` (the unresolved page name), `page` (the source page containing the link), `pos` (the start of the unresolved link) and `ref` (a reference identifying that occurrence). The X-Ray lens won't underline it. `X-Ray.md` says `range`-less objects, including `aspiring-page`, aren't shown.
